decisions.reason: As a newly launched charting plugin with visible follow-on releases and strong fit to the firm's geospatial platform business, it is a low-cost option worth keeping while market feedback is still forming.

The hierarchical search plugin is less prominently positioned than some other launches, but as a small complementary add-on its carrying cost is likely low enough to justify keeping the option open for another year.
Its homepage visibility and clear mobile-usability value suggest strategic relevance, and the firm would likely continue it until demand uncertainty resolves further.
Because this platform is presented as the flagship direction of the firm, management would be very unlikely to withdraw it so early and would continue investing through the uncertainty.

Mobile field data capture is strategically adjacent to the firm's customer workflows but more resource-intensive than a simple plugin, so it carries higher exit risk yet still merits being kept as an option.

A search extension for web map applications fits the firm's solution stack well, and its option value likely exceeds its maintenance cost despite some risk of consolidation with related search offerings.
